subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — generic host in Control UI + plugin-declared MCP servers

question: Should Phase 0 own a distinct MCP Apps sandbox-origin deployment contract and the native plugin `mcpServers` manifest API, or narrow the feature until those contracts are ready?
rationale: Tests cannot choose permanent browser-security, deployment, and plugin compatibility contracts, and the current Control UI route intentionally cannot provide stable-origin app behavior.

options.title: Own Both Contracts
options.body: Implement and document a distinct sandbox origin, prove origin-sensitive behavior, and explicitly approve the native manifest field before merge.

options.title: Narrow Phase 0
options.body: Keep explicitly experimental view-only hosting and remove stable-conformance claims plus the native manifest field.

options.title: Pause The Feature
options.body: Defer landing until the sandbox deployment and plugin ownership boundaries have dedicated designs.

recommendation.title: Own Both Contracts
recommendation.body: Implement and document a distinct sandbox origin, prove origin-sensitive behavior, and explicitly approve the native manifest field before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the requested reviewer, is explicitly asked in discussion to choose both contracts, and owns relevant current-main plugin manifest and gateway history.
